one_line: Late 13th-century Seuna-Yadava ruler of Devagiri, famed for his dramatic coup and ambitious northern campaigns.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, athletic medium build, upright martial posture
appearance.face: oval face with sharp jawline, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache without beard, intense almond-shaped dark eyes, default expression calm but alert with a strategist’s focus
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a short, tidy topknot at the crown, sides smoothly combed; wrapped with a narrow saffron cloth band as a simple turban strip, the ends tucked in rather than trailing
appearance.costume: era-accurate late 13th-century Deccan royal warrior attire: a knee-length cotton angarkha-style tunic in deep maroon with overlapping front panels tied on the right, fine golden-yellow piping along the neckline and cuffs; over this a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton brigandine vest in muted steel-grey with subtle vertical stitching, stopping just above the hip; lower body in cream-coloured tight churidar-style trousers with gathered folds at the ankles, tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching; at the waist a broad indigo cotton sash wrapped twice, knot slightly off-centre on the left with one short tail; minimal but dignified jewellery—thin gold torque necklace close to the neck, a single small gold stud in each ear, and a plain gold signet ring on his right hand; no heavy crown, only the saffron cloth headband to signal leadership with practical mobility
appearance.signature: a single slightly curved Deccan-style sword (early talwar form) with a steel-grey blade, simple disc pommel and crossguard in dull brass, carried sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard hung from a functional belt over his indigo waist sash, his right hand often resting confidently on the hilt

ref_desc: Ramachandra Deva is a medium-built, early-30s Deccan king with a maroon angarkha, steel-grey brigandine vest, cream churidar, indigo sash, saffron headband over black topknot, minimal gold jewellery, and a curved steel-grey sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Ramachandra Deva: an early-30s, medium-built Deccan ruler standing upright, with an oval medium-brown face, sharp jawline, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and intense dark almond eyes, his thick black hair pulled into a short topknot wrapped by a narrow saffron cloth headband. Show him in late 13th-century Deccan royal warrior dress: a deep maroon knee-length angarkha-style tunic with overlapping right-tied front panels and fine golden-yellow piping at neckline and cuffs, overlaid by a sleeveless fitted quilted brigandine vest in muted steel-grey with visible vertical stitching lines. His lower body has cream churidar-style trousers with soft folds at the ankles, tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching. At his waist, wrap a broad indigo cotton sash twice, knot slightly off-centre to the left with a short tail, over which a functional belt supports a dark brown leather scabbard. Include a curved Deccan-style steel-grey sword with brass disc pommel and crossguard, sheathed at his left hip, with his right hand resting lightly on the hilt in a poised, strategist-like stance. Add subtle, dignified jewellery: a thin gold torque necklace, small gold studs in both ears, and a plain gold ring on his right hand. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, indigo blue, steel grey, golden yellow accents, and cream, keeping the look historically grounded, modest, and consistently reproducible from every angle.
